name: Square API
tagline: Full-stack payments and commerce API for in-person and online businesses
description: Square provides a comprehensive REST API for payments, orders, catalogs, customers, inventory, subscriptions, and point-of-sale operations. Developers build payment apps, e-commerce backends, and business tooling with OAuth or personal access tokens against production and sandbox hosts.

auth.details: Bearer access token in Authorization header (OAuth 2.0 or personal access token). Sandbox uses sandbox tokens against connect.squareupsandbox.com. Square-Version header is recommended to pin the API version; if omitted, the application's configured default version is used.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API and SDK access is free; standard US online payment processing is currently 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction (other methods, countries, and volume agreements differ); no free transaction-fee tier for card processing
pricing.paid_plans: Transaction-based processing fees; volume discounts available; no separate API subscription for standard use

rate_limits: not published in full; some endpoints document per-endpoint limits; 429 with Retry-After on exceed
use_cases: process a card payment for an order
list business locations and their settings
create and update catalog items and prices
search customers by email or phone
create an order and take payment
generate OAuth authorize URL for a seller
